verdict.rationale: Rippling documents native integration with accounting systems (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite), which covers getting payroll data into a ledger. It also offers platform APIs with developer docs, a sandbox and an agent-oriented llms.txt, so an agent could plausibly pull data programmatically. However, nothing in the evidence shows a payroll journal endpoint or export, or an agent-driven reconciliation flow. Missing for 10: documented payroll journal/GL API endpoint or export format, evidence of agent-driven reconciliation or matching against ledger entries, hands-on or independent corroboration.
